-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vw_erb_feature_categories: View for ERBFeatureCategories
-- Combines base table columns with calculated/lookup/aggregation fields.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_erb_feature_categories CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_erb_feature_categories WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.erb_feature_category_id,                                                    -- PK = slugified category key (intake / scoring / module / validation / review / output / extraction / prep / dashboard / integration / data-model / platform / devops) — matches the value stored in ERBFeatures.Category.
  calc_erb_feature_categories_name(t.erb_feature_category_id) AS name,          -- Echoes ERBFeatureCategoryId.
  t.title,                                                                      -- Human-readable category title shown on the category filter / card.
  t.description,                                                                -- What kind of features this category groups.
  t.icon,                                                                       -- Optional emoji/glyph used as a compact visual marker for the category in the UI.
  t.sort_order,                                                                 -- Display order of the category in filters and grouped views.
  calc_erb_feature_categories_erb_features(t.erb_feature_category_id) AS erb_features,-- Reverse: features in this category.
  calc_erb_feature_categories_feature_count(t.erb_feature_category_id) AS feature_count,-- Count of ERBFeatures in this category.
  t.created_at,                                                                 -- Audit: when this row was first inserted. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on INSERT); immutable thereafter.
  t.created_by,                                                                 -- Audit: the OWNER — the JWT user (auth.email()) who created this row. Auto-stamped on INSERT; immutable thereafter. NULL for build-time seed rows (no signed-in user).
  t.modified_at,                                                                -- Audit: when this row was last written. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on every INSERT/UPDATE).
  t.modified_by,                                                                -- Audit: the JWT user (auth.email()) who last wrote this row. Auto-stamped on every INSERT/UPDATE.
  t.modified_by_model                                                           -- Audit: the AI model credited on the last save when an LLM made/assisted the change (e.g. "gpt-4o"). NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.
FROM erb_feature_categories t;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vw_erb_features: View for ERBFeatures
-- Combines base table columns with calculated/lookup/aggregation fields.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_erb_features CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_erb_features WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.erb_feature_id,                                                             -- PK — kebab logical key for the feature.
  calc_erb_features_name(t.erb_feature_id) AS name,                             -- Echoes ERBFeatureId.
  t.route,                                                                      -- Platform route this ERBFeatures row navigates to. Defaults to the "feature-detail" detail route; its template feeds RelativePath.
  calc_erb_features_route_path(t.erb_feature_id) AS route_path,                 -- The route template (with :params) pulled from the linked PlatformNaviation route.
  calc_erb_features_relative_path(t.erb_feature_id) AS relative_path,           -- Concrete relative URL for this row — the route template with its :param(s) substituted by this row's own id(s).
  t.erb_package,                                                                -- FK -> ERBPackages.ERBPackageId. The package this feature belongs to (many features -> one package).
  t.is_licensed,                                                                -- This feature's own licensing flag. When false, the feature is hidden from non-Effortless users regardless of its package (used to fence off Effortless Elements tooling features). Blank/true = licensed.
  calc_erb_features_package_is_licensed(t.erb_feature_id) AS package_is_licensed,-- Lookup: ERBPackage.IsLicensed — is this feature's owning package licensed? UI hides the feature from non-Effortless users when false.
  t.title,                                                                      -- Human-readable feature name.
  t.description,                                                                -- What the feature does, in prose.
  t.category,                                                                   -- FK to ERBFeatureCategories — the cross-package functional category this feature belongs to (intake / scoring / module / validation / review / output / extraction / prep / dashboard / integration / data-model / platform / devops).
  calc_erb_features_category_title(t.erb_feature_id) AS category_title,         -- Lookup: Category.Title — human-readable category name.
  t.status,                                                                     -- FK to ERBFeatureStatuses — feature lifecycle status.
  calc_erb_features_status_title(t.erb_feature_id) AS status_title,             -- Lookup: Status.Title.
  calc_erb_features_status_description(t.erb_feature_id) AS status_description, -- Lookup: Status.Description.
  calc_erb_features_status_is_active(t.erb_feature_id) AS status_is_active,     -- Lookup: Status.IsActive — whether this feature is part of the official shared view.
  t.sort_order,                                                                 -- Display order within the package.
  t.is_key,                                                                     -- Star flag — marks the headline features so users can focus on the top platform capabilities amid the long tail. Blank/false = ordinary features.
  t.rule_refs,                                                                  -- Comma-separated BusinessRules.RuleCode refs (R1..R38) this feature implements, if any.
  t.source_text,                                                                -- Original / supporting source text (markdown) that describes this feature.
  t.source_files,                                                               -- Comma-separated repo-relative path(s) of the source document(s).
  t.image_url,                                                                  -- Repo-relative path to a cartoon illustration of this feature (generated, 300x300 PNG under assets/feature-images/).
  t.created_at,                                                                 -- Audit: when this row was first inserted. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on INSERT); immutable thereafter.
  t.created_by,                                                                 -- Audit: the OWNER — the JWT user (auth.email()) who created this row. Auto-stamped on INSERT; immutable thereafter. NULL for build-time seed rows (no signed-in user).
  t.modified_at,                                                                -- Audit: when this row was last written. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on every INSERT/UPDATE).
  t.modified_by,                                                                -- Audit: the JWT user (auth.email()) who last wrote this row. Auto-stamped on every INSERT/UPDATE.
  t.modified_by_model                                                           -- Audit: the AI model credited on the last save when an LLM made/assisted the change (e.g. "gpt-4o"). NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.
FROM erb_features t;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vw_erb_tables: View for ERBTables
-- Combines base table columns with calculated/lookup/aggregation fields.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_erb_tables CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_erb_tables WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.erb_table_id,                                                               -- PK = the table name as it appears in the rulebook.
  calc_erb_tables_name(t.erb_table_id) AS name,                                 -- Echoes ERBTableId.
  t.table_name,                                                                 -- Table name.
  t.description,                                                                -- Table description (copied from the rulebook; refreshed additively by build).
  t.erb_package,                                                                -- FK -> ERBPackages.ERBPackageId. The package that owns this table.
  t.platform,                                                                   -- FK -> Platforms.PlatformId. The platform this table belongs to.
  calc_erb_tables_package_is_active(t.erb_table_id) AS package_is_active,       -- Lookup: ERBPackage.IsActive — is this table's owning package enabled?
  t.is_licensed,                                                                -- This table's own licensing flag. When false, the table is hidden from non-Effortless users regardless of its package (used to fence off Effortless Elements meta/catalog tables). Blank/true = licensed.
  calc_erb_tables_package_is_licensed(t.erb_table_id) AS package_is_licensed,   -- Lookup: ERBPackage.IsLicensed — is this table's owning package licensed? UI hides the table from non-Effortless users when false.
  t.field_count,                                                                -- Number of fields (refreshed by build).
  t.is_catalog,                                                                 -- TRUE for the meta/catalog tables themselves.
  t.admin_crud,                                                                 -- Admin CRUD grant for this table (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits Roles.DefaultCRUD for Admin.
  t.admin_where,                                                                -- Admin row-access policy (SQL WHERE fragment) limiting which rows of this table Admin may see. NULL = no row restriction. Source for the RLS plan.
  t.manager_crud,                                                               -- Manager CRUD grant for this table (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits Roles.DefaultCRUD for Manager.
  t.manager_where,                                                              -- Manager row-access policy (SQL WHERE fragment) limiting which rows of this table Manager may see. NULL = no row restriction. Source for the RLS plan.
  t.representative_crud,                                                        -- Representative CRUD grant for this table (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits Roles.DefaultCRUD for Representative.
  t.representative_where,                                                       -- Representative row-access policy (SQL WHERE fragment) limiting which rows of this table Representative may see. NULL = no row restriction. Source for the RLS plan.
  t.external_llm_crud,                                                          -- External LLM CRUD grant for this table (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits Roles.DefaultCRUD for External LLM.
  t.external_llm_where,                                                         -- External LLM row-access policy (SQL WHERE fragment) limiting which rows of this table External LLM may see. NULL = no row restriction. Source for the RLS plan.
  calc_erb_tables_admin_can_create(t.erb_table_id) AS admin_can_create,         -- Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when AdminCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_admin_can_read(t.erb_table_id) AS admin_can_read,             -- Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'R' (BLANK when AdminCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_admin_can_update(t.erb_table_id) AS admin_can_update,         -- Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'U' (BLANK when AdminCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_admin_can_delete(t.erb_table_id) AS admin_can_delete,         -- Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'D' (BLANK when AdminCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_manager_can_create(t.erb_table_id) AS manager_can_create,     -- Derived: ManagerCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when ManagerCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_manager_can_read(t.erb_table_id) AS manager_can_read,         -- Derived: ManagerCRUD contains 'R' (BLANK when ManagerCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_manager_can_update(t.erb_table_id) AS manager_can_update,     -- Derived: ManagerCRUD contains 'U' (BLANK when ManagerCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_manager_can_delete(t.erb_table_id) AS manager_can_delete,     -- Derived: ManagerCRUD contains 'D' (BLANK when ManagerCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_representative_can_create(t.erb_table_id) AS representative_can_create,-- Derived: RepresentativeCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when RepresentativeCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_representative_can_read(t.erb_table_id) AS representative_can_read,-- Derived: RepresentativeCRUD contains 'R' (BLANK when RepresentativeCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_representative_can_update(t.erb_table_id) AS representative_can_update,-- Derived: RepresentativeCRUD contains 'U' (BLANK when RepresentativeCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_representative_can_delete(t.erb_table_id) AS representative_can_delete,-- Derived: RepresentativeCRUD contains 'D' (BLANK when RepresentativeCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_external_llm_can_create(t.erb_table_id) AS external_llm_can_create,-- Derived: External LLMCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when External LLMCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_external_llm_can_read(t.erb_table_id) AS external_llm_can_read,-- Derived: External LLMCRUD contains 'R' (BLANK when External LLMCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_external_llm_can_update(t.erb_table_id) AS external_llm_can_update,-- Derived: External LLMCRUD contains 'U' (BLANK when External LLMCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  calc_erb_tables_external_llm_can_delete(t.erb_table_id) AS external_llm_can_delete,-- Derived: External LLMCRUD contains 'D' (BLANK when External LLMCRUD is NULL = inherits role default).
  t.admin_is_redacted,                                                          -- Per-table redaction override for Admin. NULL = inherit Roles.IsRedactedRole. TRUE/FALSE explicitly sets whether this role is redacted FOR THIS TABLE (drives the default field access on "<Field>Redacted"-paired fields).
  t.manager_is_redacted,                                                        -- Per-table redaction override for Manager. NULL = inherit Roles.IsRedactedRole. TRUE/FALSE explicitly sets whether this role is redacted FOR THIS TABLE (drives the default field access on "<Field>Redacted"-paired fields).
  t.representative_is_redacted,                                                 -- Per-table redaction override for Representative. NULL = inherit Roles.IsRedactedRole. TRUE/FALSE explicitly sets whether this role is redacted FOR THIS TABLE (drives the default field access on "<Field>Redacted"-paired fields).
  t.external_llm_is_redacted,                                                   -- Per-table redaction override for External LLM. NULL = inherit Roles.IsRedactedRole. TRUE/FALSE explicitly sets whether this role is redacted FOR THIS TABLE (drives the default field access on "<Field>Redacted"-paired fields).
  calc_erb_tables_erb_fields(t.erb_table_id) AS erb_fields,                     -- Reverse: fields belonging to this table.
  t.created_at,                                                                 -- Audit: when this row was first inserted. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on INSERT); immutable thereafter.
  t.created_by,                                                                 -- Audit: the OWNER — the JWT user (auth.email()) who created this row. Auto-stamped on INSERT; immutable thereafter. NULL for build-time seed rows (no signed-in user).
  t.modified_at,                                                                -- Audit: when this row was last written. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on every INSERT/UPDATE).
  t.modified_by,                                                                -- Audit: the JWT user (auth.email()) who last wrote this row. Auto-stamped on every INSERT/UPDATE.
  t.modified_by_model                                                           -- Audit: the AI model credited on the last save when an LLM made/assisted the change (e.g. "gpt-4o"). NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.
FROM erb_tables t;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vw_erb_fields: View for ERBFields
-- Combines base table columns with calculated/lookup/aggregation fields.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_erb_fields CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_erb_fields WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.erb_field_id,                                                               -- PK = TableName.FieldName.
  calc_erb_fields_name(t.erb_field_id) AS name,                                 -- Echoes ERBFieldId.
  t.erb_table,                                                                  -- FK to ERBTables — the field's table.
  calc_erb_fields_table_package_is_active(t.erb_field_id) AS table_package_is_active,-- Lookup: ERBTable.PackageIsActive — is the package owning this field's table enabled? (field inherits its table's package).
  t.field_name,                                                                 -- Field name.
  t.field_type,                                                                 -- raw / calculated / lookup / relationship / aggregation.
  t.datatype,                                                                   -- Field datatype.
  t.description,                                                                -- Field description (refreshed additively by build).
  calc_erb_fields_is_calculated(t.erb_field_id) AS is_calculated,               -- TRUE for calculated/lookup/aggregation (read-only at the data layer).
  t.admin_crud,                                                                 -- Admin CRUD grant for this field (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits ERBTables.AdminCRUD.
  t.manager_crud,                                                               -- Manager CRUD grant for this field (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits ERBTables.ManagerCRUD.
  t.representative_crud,                                                        -- Representative CRUD grant for this field (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits ERBTables.RepresentativeCRUD.
  t.external_llm_crud,                                                          -- External LLM CRUD grant for this field (contains C/R/U/D). NULL inherits ERBTables.External LLMCRUD.
  calc_erb_fields_admin_can_create(t.erb_field_id) AS admin_can_create,         -- Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_admin_can_read(t.erb_field_id) AS admin_can_read,             -- Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'R' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_admin_can_update(t.erb_field_id) AS admin_can_update,         -- Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'U' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_admin_can_delete(t.erb_field_id) AS admin_can_delete,         -- Derived: AdminCRUD contains 'D' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_manager_can_create(t.erb_field_id) AS manager_can_create,     -- Derived: ManagerCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_manager_can_read(t.erb_field_id) AS manager_can_read,         -- Derived: ManagerCRUD contains 'R' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_manager_can_update(t.erb_field_id) AS manager_can_update,     -- Derived: ManagerCRUD contains 'U' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_manager_can_delete(t.erb_field_id) AS manager_can_delete,     -- Derived: ManagerCRUD contains 'D' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_representative_can_create(t.erb_field_id) AS representative_can_create,-- Derived: RepresentativeCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_representative_can_read(t.erb_field_id) AS representative_can_read,-- Derived: RepresentativeCRUD contains 'R' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_representative_can_update(t.erb_field_id) AS representative_can_update,-- Derived: RepresentativeCRUD contains 'U' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_representative_can_delete(t.erb_field_id) AS representative_can_delete,-- Derived: RepresentativeCRUD contains 'D' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_external_llm_can_create(t.erb_field_id) AS external_llm_can_create,-- Derived: External LLMCRUD contains 'C' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_external_llm_can_read(t.erb_field_id) AS external_llm_can_read,-- Derived: External LLMCRUD contains 'R' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_external_llm_can_update(t.erb_field_id) AS external_llm_can_update,-- Derived: External LLMCRUD contains 'U' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  calc_erb_fields_external_llm_can_delete(t.erb_field_id) AS external_llm_can_delete,-- Derived: External LLMCRUD contains 'D' (BLANK when NULL = inherits table/role).
  t.created_at,                                                                 -- Audit: when this row was first inserted. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on INSERT); immutable thereafter.
  t.created_by,                                                                 -- Audit: the OWNER — the JWT user (auth.email()) who created this row. Auto-stamped on INSERT; immutable thereafter. NULL for build-time seed rows (no signed-in user).
  t.modified_at,                                                                -- Audit: when this row was last written. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on every INSERT/UPDATE).
  t.modified_by,                                                                -- Audit: the JWT user (auth.email()) who last wrote this row. Auto-stamped on every INSERT/UPDATE.
  t.modified_by_model                                                           -- Audit: the AI model credited on the last save when an LLM made/assisted the change (e.g. "gpt-4o"). NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.
FROM erb_fields t;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vw_api_endpoints: View for APIEndpoints
-- Combines base table columns with calculated/lookup/aggregation fields.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_api_endpoints CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_api_endpoints WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.api_endpoint_id,                                                            -- Slug PK, e.g. 'checklist-run-analysis'.
  calc_api_endpoints_name(t.api_endpoint_id) AS name,                           -- Echoes APIEndpointId.
  t.title,                                                                      -- Human-readable endpoint name.
  t.description,                                                                -- What the endpoint does.
  t.http_method,                                                                -- GET / POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE.
  t.path,                                                                       -- URL path, e.g. '/api/checklists/:id/run-analysis'.
  t.endpoint_type,                                                              -- ACTION / RPC / REPORT / WEBHOOK / BATCH — distinguishes from standard CRUD.
  t.subject_table_name,                                                         -- Primary table this endpoint acts on (raw string convention; may be blank for cross-table actions).
  t.role_visibility,                                                            -- Comma-separated canonical roles allowed to call this endpoint (Admin / Manager / Representative / Operations).
  t.where_clause,                                                               -- Optional row-access policy applied to the endpoint's subject, mirroring ERBTables.{Role}WHERE.
  t.triggers_state_machine,                                                     -- StateMachineId this endpoint can advance, if any (convention string).
  t.status,                                                                     -- Lifecycle status (mirrors ERBFeatureStatuses keys). DESIGNED for not-yet-built.
  t.created_at,                                                                 -- Audit: when this row was first inserted. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on INSERT); immutable thereafter.
  t.created_by,                                                                 -- Audit: the OWNER — the JWT user (auth.email()) who created this row. Auto-stamped on INSERT; immutable thereafter. NULL for build-time seed rows (no signed-in user).
  t.modified_at,                                                                -- Audit: when this row was last written. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on every INSERT/UPDATE).
  t.modified_by,                                                                -- Audit: the JWT user (auth.email()) who last wrote this row. Auto-stamped on every INSERT/UPDATE.
  t.modified_by_model                                                           -- Audit: the AI model credited on the last save when an LLM made/assisted the change (e.g. "gpt-4o"). NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.
FROM api_endpoints t;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vw_subject_state_instances: View for SubjectStateInstances
-- Combines base table columns with calculated/lookup/aggregation fields.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_subject_state_instances CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_subject_state_instances WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.subject_state_instance_id,                                                  -- PK: ssi-{subject-table}-{subject-id}-{state-key}-{sequence-index}.
  calc_subject_state_instances_name(t.subject_state_instance_id) AS name,       -- Echoes SubjectStateInstanceId.
  t.state_machine,                                                              -- FK -> StateMachines.StateMachineId.
  t.subject_table_name,                                                         -- Polymorphic table name, e.g. Citations or Hearings.
  t.subject_id,                                                                 -- Polymorphic PK of the subject row.
  t.state_key,                                                                  -- The machine state entered by this occupancy record.
  t.entered_at,                                                                 -- Timestamp when this state was entered.
  t.exited_at,                                                                  -- Timestamp when the subject left this state. NULL while current.
  t.sequence_index,                                                             -- 1-based position on this subject's path through the machine.
  t.prior_instance,                                                             -- Self-FK -> SubjectStateInstances.SubjectStateInstanceId — the previous occupancy in this subject's chain. NULL for the initial state.
  t.entered_via_transition,                                                     -- FK -> StateTransitions.StateTransitionId — the edge event that created this occupancy.
  calc_subject_state_instances_is_current(t.subject_state_instance_id) AS is_current,-- TRUE when ExitedAt IS NULL — this is the subject's active state.
  calc_subject_state_instances_has_complete_lineage(t.subject_state_instance_id) AS has_complete_lineage,-- TRUE when the PriorInstance chain walks back to SequenceIndex=1 (the initial state occupancy). Validates lineage completeness.
  t.created_at,                                                                 -- Audit: when this row was first inserted. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on INSERT); immutable thereafter.
  t.created_by,                                                                 -- Audit: the OWNER — the JWT user (auth.email()) who created this row. Auto-stamped on INSERT; immutable thereafter. NULL for build-time seed rows (no signed-in user).
  t.modified_at,                                                                -- Audit: when this row was last written. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on every INSERT/UPDATE).
  t.modified_by,                                                                -- Audit: the JWT user (auth.email()) who last wrote this row. Auto-stamped on every INSERT/UPDATE.
  t.modified_by_model                                                           -- Audit: the AI model credited on the last save when an LLM made/assisted the change (e.g. "gpt-4o"). NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.
FROM subject_state_instances t;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vw_violation_types: View for ViolationTypes
-- Combines base table columns with calculated/lookup/aggregation fields.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_violation_types CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_violation_types WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.violation_type_id,                                                          -- Surrogate key for the violation type (off-screen).
  calc_violation_types_name(t.violation_type_id) AS name,                       -- Kebab-cased PK derived from the violation code (e.g. 'CVC-22350' -> 'cvc-22350').
  t.is_mock_data,                                                               -- TRUE for seed/demo rows; distinguishes mock data from real records.
  t.code,                                                                       -- Statute/vehicle-code reference for the violation, e.g. 'CVC-22350'.
  t.jurisdiction,                                                               -- FK to the Jurisdiction whose rules govern this violation type.
  calc_violation_types_jurisdiction_label(t.violation_type_id) AS jurisdiction_label,-- Display name of the governing jurisdiction.
  t.description,                                                                -- Plain-English description of the violation, e.g. 'Unsafe speed for conditions'.
  t.base_fine_usd,                                                              -- Base fine amount in USD for this violation before any penalties or reductions.
  t.points,                                                                     -- License points assessed for a conviction of this violation.
  calc_violation_types_traffic_school_point_cap(t.violation_type_id) AS traffic_school_point_cap,-- The governing jurisdiction's traffic-school point cap, looked up from Jurisdictions.
  calc_violation_types_is_school_eligible_by_cap(t.violation_type_id) AS is_school_eligible_by_cap,-- Whether this violation's points fall at or below the jurisdiction's traffic-school point cap (jurisdiction rule applied to the violation).
  t.citations,                                                                  -- Reverse FK: citations issued for this violation type.
  calc_violation_types_count_of_citations(t.violation_type_id) AS count_of_citations,-- Number of citations issued for this violation type.

NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.

-- vw_drivers: View for Drivers

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_drivers CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_drivers WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.driver_id,                                                                  -- Surrogate key for the driver (off-screen).
  calc_drivers_name(t.driver_id) AS name,                                       -- Kebab-cased PK derived from the license number (e.g. 'D1234567' -> 'd1234567').
  t.is_mock_data,                                                               -- TRUE for seed/demo rows; distinguishes mock data from real records.
  t.license_number,                                                             -- Driver's license number; the natural identifier for the driver.
  t.first_name,                                                                 -- Driver's first name.
  t.last_name,                                                                  -- Driver's last name.
  calc_drivers_full_name(t.driver_id) AS full_name,                             -- Display name, last-comma-first.
  t.home_jurisdiction,                                                          -- FK to the Jurisdiction that issued the driver's license (governs point/suspension rules for the driver).
  calc_drivers_home_jurisdiction_label(t.driver_id) AS home_jurisdiction_label, -- Display name of the driver's home jurisdiction.
  calc_drivers_suspension_threshold(t.driver_id) AS suspension_threshold,       -- Point-suspension threshold pulled from the driver's home jurisdiction.
  calc_drivers_warning_threshold(t.driver_id) AS warning_threshold,             -- Point-warning threshold pulled from the driver's home jurisdiction.
  t.citations,                                                                  -- Reverse FK: citations issued to this driver.
  calc_drivers_count_of_citations(t.driver_id) AS count_of_citations,           -- Number of citations issued to this driver.
  calc_drivers_active_points(t.driver_id) AS active_points,                     -- Sum of license points across this driver's citations that resulted in a conviction (guilty/unpaid-default) and are still point-active.
  calc_drivers_license_status(t.driver_id) AS license_status,                   -- License-points state machine for the driver: Suspended at/above the suspension threshold, Warning at/above the warning threshold, otherwise Valid.
  t.created_at,                                                                 -- Audit: when this row was first inserted. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on INSERT); immutable thereafter.
  t.created_by,                                                                 -- Audit: the OWNER — the JWT user (auth.email()) who created this row. Auto-stamped on INSERT; immutable thereafter. NULL for build-time seed rows (no signed-in user).
  t.modified_at,                                                                -- Audit: when this row was last written. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on every INSERT/UPDATE).
  t.modified_by,                                                                -- Audit: the JWT user (auth.email()) who last wrote this row. Auto-stamped on every INSERT/UPDATE.
  t.modified_by_model                                                           -- Audit: the AI model credited on the last save when an LLM made/assisted the change (e.g. "gpt-4o"). NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.
FROM drivers t;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vw_citations: View for Citations
-- Combines base table columns with calculated/lookup/aggregation fields.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_citations CASCADE;
CREATE VIEW vw_citations WITH (security_invoker = ON) AS
SELECT
  t.citation_id,                                                                -- Surrogate key for the citation (off-screen).
  calc_citations_name(t.citation_id) AS name,                                   -- Kebab-cased PK derived from the citation number (e.g. 'TC-2026-0001' -> 'tc-2026-0001').
  t.is_mock_data,                                                               -- TRUE for seed/demo rows; distinguishes mock data from real records.
  t.citation_number,                                                            -- Human citation/ticket number printed on the ticket.
  t.driver,                                                                     -- FK to the cited Driver.
  calc_citations_driver_label(t.citation_id) AS driver_label,                   -- Display name of the cited driver.
  t.violation_type,                                                             -- FK to the cited ViolationType.
  calc_citations_violation_label(t.citation_id) AS violation_label,             -- Description of the cited violation.
  t.jurisdiction,                                                               -- FK to the Jurisdiction in which the citation was issued (governs deadlines, penalties, points).
  calc_citations_jurisdiction_label(t.citation_id) AS jurisdiction_label,       -- Display name of the issuing jurisdiction.
  calc_citations_base_fine_usd(t.citation_id) AS base_fine_usd,                 -- Base fine for the cited violation, pulled from the ViolationType.
  calc_citations_violation_points(t.citation_id) AS violation_points,           -- License points for the cited violation, pulled from the ViolationType.
  t.issued_on,                                                                  -- Date the citation was issued to the driver.
  t.as_of_date,                                                                 -- The 'today' reference date used to evaluate deadlines for this citation (lets seed data exercise overdue/late states deterministically).
  t.responded_on,                                                               -- Date the driver responded (paid or requested a hearing). Null if no response yet.
  t.contest_requested,                                                          -- Whether the driver elected to contest the citation (request a hearing) rather than pay.
  t.paid_on,                                                                    -- Date the fine was paid in full. Null if not yet paid.
  t.amount_paid_usd,                                                            -- Total amount the driver has paid against this citation. Null/0 if nothing paid.
  calc_citations_days_to_respond(t.citation_id) AS days_to_respond,             -- Response window in days, pulled from the issuing jurisdiction.
  calc_citations_days_to_pay_after_ruling(t.citation_id) AS days_to_pay_after_ruling,-- Days-to-pay window, pulled from the issuing jurisdiction.
  calc_citations_late_penalty_pct(t.citation_id) AS late_penalty_pct,           -- Late-penalty percentage, pulled from the issuing jurisdiction.
  calc_citations_days_late_to_collections(t.citation_id) AS days_late_to_collections,-- Days-late-to-collections window, pulled from the issuing jurisdiction.
  calc_citations_response_due_date(t.citation_id) AS response_due_date,         -- Deadline to respond: IssuedOn + the jurisdiction's response window.
  calc_citations_days_until_response_due(t.citation_id) AS days_until_response_due,-- Days remaining (negative if overdue) until the response deadline, measured from AsOfDate.
  calc_citations_is_response_overdue(t.citation_id) AS is_response_overdue,     -- True when no response was filed and the response deadline has passed as of AsOfDate.
  calc_citations_count_of_hearings(t.citation_id) AS count_of_hearings,         -- Number of hearing records attached to this citation.
  calc_citations_latest_hearing_outcome(t.citation_id) AS latest_hearing_outcome,-- Outcome of the most recent hearing for this citation (Pending if a hearing exists but has no outcome; blank if no hearing).
  calc_citations_contest_status(t.citation_id) AS contest_status,               -- Contest/Hearing state machine: NotContested when the driver did not elect to contest; otherwise HearingRequested -> Scheduled -> Heard, reflected from the latest hearing's outcome.
  calc_citations_is_dismissed(t.citation_id) AS is_dismissed,                   -- True when the latest hearing outcome dismissed the citation.
  calc_citations_is_guilty(t.citation_id) AS is_guilty,                         -- True when the driver is liable: either found guilty/upheld at hearing, or defaulted by missing the response deadline without contesting.
  calc_citations_amount_due_usd(t.citation_id) AS amount_due_usd,               -- Amount currently owed: 0 if dismissed; otherwise the base fine plus the jurisdiction's late penalty if the payment is late.
  calc_citations_payment_due_date(t.citation_id) AS payment_due_date,           -- Date the fine is due: the later anchor (response deadline) plus the jurisdiction's days-to-pay window.
  calc_citations_is_payment_late(t.citation_id) AS is_payment_late,             -- True when the driver is liable, has not paid in full, and the payment due date has passed as of AsOfDate.
  calc_citations_collections_deadline(t.citation_id) AS collections_deadline,   -- Date the account moves to collections: PaymentDueDate plus the jurisdiction's grace window.
  calc_citations_is_in_collections(t.citation_id) AS is_in_collections,         -- True when a late payment has remained unpaid past the jurisdiction's collections window.
  calc_citations_payment_status(t.citation_id) AS payment_status,               -- Payment/Penalty state machine: NotOwed (dismissed) -> Paid -> Collections -> Late -> Due. Evaluated in priority order.
  calc_citations_effective_points(t.citation_id) AS effective_points,           -- License points this citation actually contributes to the driver: the violation's points if the driver is liable and not dismissed, otherwise 0. Drives the driver's ActivePoints rollup.
  calc_citations_citation_status(t.citation_id) AS citation_status,             -- Citation lifecycle state machine: Issued -> Responded -> InContest -> Adjudicated -> Closed. The top-level status synthesizing the other tracks.
  t.hearings,                                                                   -- Reverse FK: hearing records for this citation.
  t.payments,                                                                   -- Reverse FK: payment records for this citation.
  t.case_events,                                                                -- Reverse FK: append-only case-event log entries for this citation.
  t.created_at,                                                                 -- Audit: when this row was first inserted. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on INSERT); immutable thereafter.
  t.created_by,                                                                 -- Audit: the OWNER — the JWT user (auth.email()) who created this row. Auto-stamped on INSERT; immutable thereafter. NULL for build-time seed rows (no signed-in user).
  t.modified_at,                                                                -- Audit: when this row was last written. Auto-stamped by the audit trigger (now() on every INSERT/UPDATE).
  t.modified_by,                                                                -- Audit: the JWT user (auth.email()) who last wrote this row. Auto-stamped on every INSERT/UPDATE.
  t.modified_by_model                                                           -- Audit: the AI model credited on the last save when an LLM made/assisted the change (e.g. "gpt-4o"). NULL for plain human writes. Read from the app.modified_by_model session GUC by the audit trigger. The owner (CreatedBy/ModifiedBy) is always the human JWT user, never a model.
FROM citations t;

VALUES ('rule-tt-intake-02', 'TT-INTAKE-02', 'Issue date present and not future-dated', 'intake', 101, 'Every citation records an IssueDate that is on or before today; a future issue date is rejected at intake.', 'Citations.IssueDate', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (business_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET rule_code = EXCLUDED.rule_code, title = EXCLUDED.title, category = EXCLUDED.category, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, description = EXCLUDED.description, schema_location = EXCLUDED.schema_location, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('rule-tt-intake-03', 'TT-INTAKE-03', 'Driver response is pay-or-contest before the deadline', 'intake', 102, 'The driver''s response is one of {pay, contest} and must be recorded on or before the computed ResponseDeadline.', 'Citations.DriverResponse / Citations.ResponseDeadline', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (business_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET rule_code = EXCLUDED.rule_code, title = EXCLUDED.title, category = EXCLUDED.category, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, description = EXCLUDED.description, schema_location = EXCLUDED.schema_location, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('rule-tt-citation-02', 'TT-CITATION-02', 'Status order is monotonic', 'citation-lifecycle', 105, 'A citation may only advance forward through its lifecycle states; backward transitions require an explicit, logged override.', 'Citations.CitationStatus / CaseEvents', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (business_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET rule_code = EXCLUDED.rule_code, title = EXCLUDED.title, category = EXCLUDED.category, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, description = EXCLUDED.description, schema_location = EXCLUDED.schema_location, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('rule-tt-assistant-02', 'TT-ASSISTANT-02', 'Every turn is cost-accounted', 'assistant', 121, 'Each AssistantTurns row records input/output tokens and a computed cost via ModelPricingVersions for the turn''s AiModel.', 'AssistantTurns.InputTokens / OutputTokens / Cost <- ModelPricingVersions', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (business_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET rule_code = EXCLUDED.rule_code, title = EXCLUDED.title, category = EXCLUDED.category, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, description = EXCLUDED.description, schema_location = EXCLUDED.schema_location, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('rule-tt-rbac-02', 'TT-RBAC-02', 'CRUD is per role, per table, per field', 'rbac', 125, 'What each role may create/read/update/delete is data at the table and field grain; the enforced API consults it on every operation.', 'Roles / ERBTables.*CRUD / ERBFields', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (business_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET rule_code = EXCLUDED.rule_code, title = EXCLUDED.title, category = EXCLUDED.category, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, description = EXCLUDED.description, schema_location = EXCLUDED.schema_location, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('rule-tt-rbac-04', 'TT-RBAC-04', 'Lower-trust roles get redacted projections', 'rbac', 127, 'Fields denied to a role (e.g. PII for external-llm) are stripped from responses at projection time, not nulled afterward.', 'ERBFields (field CRUD) / role-specific views', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (business_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET rule_code = EXCLUDED.rule_code, title = EXCLUDED.title, category = EXCLUDED.category, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, description = EXCLUDED.description, schema_location = EXCLUDED.schema_location, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

Failure to appear may result in a civil assessment and referral for collection.', 'Source for CA-LA DaysToRespond = 21 and the default-judgment behavior.', NULL, '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (jurisdiction_source_document_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, jurisdiction = EXCLUDED.jurisdiction, doc_type = EXCLUDED.doc_type, relative_file_path = EXCLUDED.relative_file_path, source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, extracted_text = EXCLUDED.extracted_text, notes = EXCLUDED.notes, jurisdiction_rules = EXCLUDED.jurisdiction_rules, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

Accumulating 11 points within 18 months may result in license suspension; the DMV may also act on fewer points for serious offenses.', 'Source for NY-NYC PointSuspensionThreshold = 11 and PointWarningThreshold = 6.', NULL, '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (jurisdiction_source_document_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, jurisdiction = EXCLUDED.jurisdiction, doc_type = EXCLUDED.doc_type, relative_file_path = EXCLUDED.relative_file_path, source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, extracted_text = EXCLUDED.extracted_text, notes = EXCLUDED.notes, jurisdiction_rules = EXCLUDED.jurisdiction_rules, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('doc-tx-aus-appeal-2025-114', 'Travis County Appeal Board Decision 2025-114 (Radar Calibration)', 'j-tx-aus', 'appeal-board-decision', 'git-ignored-examples/jurisdiction-rules/tx-aus-appeal-2025-114.pdf', 'https://www.traviscountytx.gov/justice-of-the-peace', 'Where the issuing agency cannot produce radar/lidar calibration records upon timely request, the speed measurement is unreliable and the citation must be dismissed. VALUES ('jr-ca-respond-21', NULL, 'CA-VC-§40519', '21-Day Response Window', 'An infraction defendant must appear or post bail within 21 days of the notice to appear; otherwise a civil assessment and collections referral may follow.', 'deadline', '2026-01-01', 'https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=VEH', 'In LA County you have 21 days from your ticket date to pay or ask for a hearing. VALUES ('jr-ca-school-1pt', NULL, 'CA-LA-TS-1', 'Traffic School Masks One Point', 'An eligible driver may attend traffic school once per 18 months to mask one point from a qualifying moving violation.', 'license', '2026-01-01', 'https://www.courts.ca.gov/traffic.htm', 'In LA County you can take traffic school once every 18 months to hide one point from your record.', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'gpt-4o-mini', 'doc-ca-traffic-school', 'j-ca-la', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', 'gpt-4o-mini') ON CONFLICT (jurisdiction_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, rule_number = EXCLUDED.rule_number, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, effective_date = EXCLUDED.effective_date, citation_url = EXCLUDED.citation_url, ai_version = EXCLUDED.ai_version, ai_version_updated_at = EXCLUDED.ai_version_updated_at, ai_version_model = EXCLUDED.ai_version_model, source_document = EXCLUDED.source_document, jurisdiction = EXCLUDED.jurisdiction, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('jr-tx-respond-14', NULL, 'TX-TC-§543', '14-Day Response Window', 'A defendant must respond to a citation within the period stated on the notice, commonly 14 days, or a warrant and additional fees may issue.', 'deadline', '2026-01-01', 'https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.545.htm', 'In Travis County you usually have 14 days to respond to a ticket before a warrant and extra fees can be added.', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'gpt-4o-mini', 'doc-tx-transportation-code', 'j-tx-aus', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', 'gpt-4o-mini') ON CONFLICT (jurisdiction_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, rule_number = EXCLUDED.rule_number, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, effective_date = EXCLUDED.effective_date, citation_url = EXCLUDED.citation_url, ai_version = EXCLUDED.ai_version, ai_version_updated_at = EXCLUDED.ai_version_updated_at, ai_version_model = EXCLUDED.ai_version_model, source_document = EXCLUDED.source_document, jurisdiction = EXCLUDED.jurisdiction, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('jr-tx-radar-dismiss', NULL, 'TX-AUS-AB-2025-114', 'No Calibration Records → Dismissal', 'If the agency cannot produce radar/lidar calibration records on timely request, the speed reading is unreliable and the citation must be dismissed.', 'evidence', '2025-11-01', 'https://www.traviscountytx.gov/justice-of-the-peace', 'In Travis County, if the police can''t show their radar was calibrated, a speeding ticket can be thrown out — exactly what happened on TC-2026-0003.', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'gpt-4o', 'doc-tx-aus-appeal-2025-114', 'j-tx-aus', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', 'gpt-4o') ON CONFLICT (jurisdiction_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, rule_number = EXCLUDED.rule_number, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, effective_date = EXCLUDED.effective_date, citation_url = EXCLUDED.citation_url, ai_version = EXCLUDED.ai_version, ai_version_updated_at = EXCLUDED.ai_version_updated_at, ai_version_model = EXCLUDED.ai_version_model, source_document = EXCLUDED.source_document, jurisdiction = EXCLUDED.jurisdiction, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core', 'Core Platform', 'Cross-cutting platform machinery shared by all packages: the rulebook-driven permission model, role-specific schemas, the enforced CRUD API, row-level security, the generic state-machine backbone, the work queue, and dev-ops/build tooling.', 'shipped', TRUE, TRUE, 2, TRUE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_package_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, status = EXCLUDED.status, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, erb_features = EXCLUDED.erb_features, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('platform-meta', 'Platform Meta & Knowledge Base', 'The self-describing meta layer you usually keep hidden: the feature catalog and statuses, the table/field schema catalog, the custom API-endpoint registry, ERB versions, customizations, the glossary, and the business-rule library. Turn this off and the entire "how the platform describes itself" surface disappears, leaving just the working app.', 'shipped', TRUE, TRUE, 3, TRUE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_package_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, status = EXCLUDED.status, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, erb_features = EXCLUDED.erb_features, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_packages (erb_package_id, title, description, status, is_active, is_licensed, sort_order, is_key, source_text, source_files, erb_features, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('access-control', 'Roles & User Management', 'The role/user administration surface: the Roles catalog and the AppUsers directory, plus the role/user admin pages and the permission model (role→table→field CRUD, per-role WHERE policies, role-specific schemas, derived RLS). Turn it OFF and an admin temporarily loses the management tools — a quick way to see the simpler app a non-admin sees. The underlying RLS keeps enforcing in Postgres regardless; this only hides the management UI.', 'shipped', TRUE, TRUE, 4, FALSE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_package_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, status = EXCLUDED.status, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, erb_features = EXCLUDED.erb_features, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('state-machines', 'State Machine Admin', 'The state-machine configuration surface: the StateMachines / MachineStates / StateTransitionRules / StateTransitions tables and the admin routes that view and edit them (machines, states, transition rules, transition log). VALUES ('assistant', 'Assistant & Cost Analytics', 'The portal assistant (the chat-agent state machine) plus its cost/usage telemetry: the AI model catalog (AiModels), the versioned model price book (ModelPricingVersions), and per-turn AssistantTurns rows whose token costs roll up to accounts and records. INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('citation-intake', 'nav-citations-detail', 'citations', TRUE, 'Citation Intake', 'Record a new traffic citation — driver, violation type, issuing jurisdiction, issue date — and immediately derive its response deadline from the jurisdiction''s DaysToRespond rule.', 'intake', 'shipped', 1, FALSE, 'TT-INTAKE-01,TT-INTAKE-02,TT-DEADLINE-01', 'Records a new traffic citation as a row in the Citations table -- driver (FK to Drivers), violation type (FK to ViolationTypes), issuing jurisdiction (FK to Jurisdictions), and issue date -- and immediately derives the response deadline from the jurisdiction''s DaysToRespond rule via vw_citations. An admin or representative captures the citation off a paper ticket and the computed ResponseDeadline column appears the moment the row is saved, with no manual date math. This is the front door of the whole citation-lifecycle state machine.', 'README.md', '/assets/feature-images/citation-intake.png', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('driver-response', 'nav-citations-detail', 'citations', TRUE, 'Driver Response', 'Capture the driver''s choice — pay now or request a hearing — and advance the citation from Issued to Responded before the response window closes.', 'intake', 'shipped', 2, FALSE, 'TT-INTAKE-03,TT-CONTEST-01', 'Captures the driver''s choice -- pay now or request a hearing -- writing it onto the Citations row and advancing the citation from Issued to Responded in vw_citations before the response window closes. A representative records the decision on behalf of the cited driver, and the contest-track state machine branches on it. The response and its timestamp become CaseEvents rows so the audit trail explains every move.', 'README.md', '/assets/feature-images/driver-response.png', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('contest-track', 'nav-citations-detail', 'citations', TRUE, 'Contest Tracker', 'Derive the contest track (NotContested | HearingRequested → Scheduled → Heard) from the latest hearing, driving liability downstream.', 'state-machine', 'shipped', 4, FALSE, 'TT-CONTEST-02,TT-CONTEST-03,TT-HEARING-01', 'Derives the contest track (NotContested | HearingRequested -> Scheduled -> Heard) from the latest Hearings row, surfacing it as a calculated column on vw_citations that drives liability downstream. The track feeds the determination logic that decides whether a fine is owed.', 'README.md', '/assets/feature-images/contest-track.png', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('payment-track', 'nav-payments', 'citations', TRUE, 'Payment & Penalty Tracker', 'Compute the payment track (Pending → Due → Late → Collections | Paid | NotOwed) including the jurisdiction-specific late penalty once the pay-by date passes.', 'state-machine', 'in-progress', 5, FALSE, 'TT-PAYMENT-01,TT-PAYMENT-02,TT-FEE-01', 'Computes the payment track (Pending -> Due -> Late -> Collections | Paid | NotOwed) on vw_citations, including the jurisdiction-specific late penalty once the pay-by date passes, by joining Citations, Payments, and the jurisdiction''s penalty rule. A representative or driver sees the live amount owed and its escalation status. The Late and Collections transitions are the ones the deadline-driven work queue watches most.', 'README.md', '/assets/feature-images/payment-track.png', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('license-points', 'nav-drivers', 'citations', TRUE, 'License Points Monitor', 'Roll up a driver''s active points and drive the license track (Valid → Warning → Suspended) against each jurisdiction''s warning and suspension thresholds.', 'license', 'in-progress', 6, FALSE, 'TT-LICENSE-01,TT-LICENSE-02', 'Rolls up a driver''s active points across their Citations and drives the license track (Valid -> Warning -> Suspended) against each jurisdiction''s warning and suspension thresholds, exposed on vw_drivers. INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('jurisdiction-rules', 'nav-jurisdictions', 'citations', TRUE, 'Jurisdiction Rules Engine', 'Edit a jurisdiction''s deadlines, fines, penalty percentages, and point thresholds as data — and watch every citation under it re-derive instantly, with no code change and no migration.', 'rules-engine', 'shipped', 7, FALSE, 'TT-RULES-01,TT-DEADLINE-01,TT-FEE-01', 'Lets an admin edit a jurisdiction''s deadlines, fines, penalty percentages, and point thresholds as data in the Jurisdictions and JurisdictionRules tables -- and every citation under it re-derives instantly through vw_citations with no code change and no migration. A manager turns a single dial and the whole region''s computed deadlines and penalties move. This is the rules-as-data thesis of the entire platform.', 'README.md', '/assets/feature-images/jurisdiction-rules.png', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('hearing-scheduling', 'nav-hearings', 'citations', TRUE, 'Hearing Scheduling', 'Request a hearing, let a manager schedule it, and record the outcome — driving the contest track and the citation''s liability.', 'hearings', 'shipped', 8, FALSE, 'TT-HEARING-01,TT-HEARING-02,TT-CONTEST-03', 'Requests a hearing, lets a manager schedule it, and records the outcome as a Hearings row, driving the contest track and the citation''s liability on vw_citations. A representative requests, a manager assigns a date, and the recorded outcome flows back to determine whether a fine survives. Each step writes a CaseEvents row so the timeline is complete.', 'README.md', '/assets/feature-images/hearing-scheduling.png', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('payment-checkout', 'nav-citations-pay', 'citations', TRUE, 'Online Payment', 'Pay a citation''s fine online in full, record the payment, and close the case — the path Aisha Khan took on citation TC-2026-0005.', 'payments', 'shipped', 9, FALSE, 'TT-PAYMENT-01,TT-PAYMENT-03', 'Pays a citation''s fine online in full, records a Payments row, and closes the case on vw_citations -- the path Aisha Khan took on citation TC-2026-0005. A representative or driver completes checkout and the payment track flips to Paid. The closing transition is logged to CaseEvents and removes the item from the work queue.', 'README.md', '/assets/feature-images/payment-checkout.png', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('work-queue', 'nav-work-queue', 'citations', TRUE, 'Work Queue', 'A single prioritized list of everything needing attention now — overdue responses, due payments, upcoming hearings — bucketed by urgency.', 'workqueue', 'shipped', 10, FALSE, 'TT-DEADLINE-01,TT-QUEUE-01', 'Surfaces a single prioritized list of everything needing attention now -- overdue responses, due payments, upcoming hearings -- as WorkQueueItems rows bucketed by urgency, computed from the deadline columns on vw_citations. VALUES ('audit-trail', 'nav-admin-audit-log', 'citations', TRUE, 'Audit Trail', 'Every status change, override, and edit on a citation is logged append-only — a full history that sits alongside, and explains, the computed current state.', 'audit', 'shipped', 11, FALSE, 'TT-AUDIT-01,TT-AUDIT-02', 'Logs every status change, override, and edit on a citation append-only into AuditLogEntries and CaseEvents, a full history that sits alongside -- and explains -- the computed current state in vw_citations. A manager investigating a dispute opens the trail and sees exactly who changed what and when. The append-only log never contradicts the derived state; it narrates how the state got there.', 'README.md', '/assets/feature-images/audit-trail.png', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-06T12:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('ai-assistant', 'nav-assistant', 'citations', TRUE, 'AI Case Assistant', 'Ask plain-language questions about a citation, the rules, or the portal and get an answer — with input/output token usage and per-model cost tracked for every turn.', 'assistant', 'in-progress', 12, FALSE, 'TT-ASSISTANT-01,TT-ASSISTANT-02', 'Answers plain-language questions about a citation, the rules, or the portal by writing AssistantTurns rows, with input/output token usage and per-model cost tracked for every turn against AiModels and ModelPricingVersions. A representative asks ''what''s my deadline on TC-2026-0002?'' and gets a grounded answer plus a logged cost. VALUES ('glossary', 'nav-library-glossary', 'citations', TRUE, 'Glossary', 'Plain-language definitions of every term in the domain — citation, jurisdiction, contest, collections, points — grouped by category.', 'library', 'shipped', 13, FALSE, 'TT-GLOSSARY-01', 'Presents plain-language definitions of every domain term -- citation, jurisdiction, contest, collections, points -- as GlossaryTerms rows grouped by GlossaryCategories. A representative researching a contest reads the actual authority behind a deadline or penalty. VALUES ('multi-jurisdiction-dashboard', 'nav-dashboard', 'citations', TRUE, 'Multi-Jurisdiction Dashboard', 'A top-level dashboard comparing the three jurisdictions side by side — response windows, fines, penalties, point thresholds — so the rules engine is visible at a glance.', 'rules-engine', 'designed', 16, FALSE, 'TT-RULES-01,TT-QUEUE-01', 'Aggregates citation volume, contest rates, payment status, and average points by jurisdiction into a dashboard reading from vw_citations and vw_drivers across all Jurisdictions rows. A manager compares CA-LA, NY-NYC, and TX-AUS at a glance and spots where deadlines or penalties are biting.
