VALUES ('core-roles-vocabulary', 'nav-admin-roles', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Canonical roles table', 'Roles meta table — single queryable role vocabulary (Admin/Manager/Representative/External-LLM) with DefaultCRUD; AppUsers and the domain actor tables FK into it.', 'platform', 'designed', 30, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-01', 'Defines the canonical four-role vocabulary (admin, manager, representative, external-llm) as Roles rows that every permission, navigation, and redaction decision references. An admin manages the role catalog from one screen and the rest of the platform inherits it. There is exactly one source of truth for who the actors are.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-role-permission-model', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Role→Table→Field CRUD permission model', 'Additive/subtractive CRUD permissions. Resolution per (role,table,field,op): effective = ERBFields.{Role}CRUD ?? ERBTables.{Role}CRUD ?? Roles.DefaultCRUD (field overrides table overrides role default; NULL inherits the parent). op_allowed = effective CONTAINS the C/R/U/D letter (no dashes; e.g. CRUD, RU, RD). Derived {Role}Can{Op} booleans are BLANK when the source is NULL so inherit is distinguishable from explicit deny. Seed posture: Admin/Manager DefaultCRUD=CRUD, Rep/External-LLM=R; table grants NULL; calculated/lookup/aggregation fields pinned to R, raw fields NULL.', 'platform', 'designed', 31, TRUE, 'TT-RBAC-01,TT-RBAC-02', 'Encodes the Role -> Table -> Field CRUD permission model as data so that what each role may create, read, update, or delete is a row, not a hardcoded guard. An admin edits a grid and the enforced CRUD API changes behavior immediately. This declarative matrix is the backbone of the platform''s RBAC.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-table-where-policies', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Per-role table WHERE policies', 'Each ERBTables row carries a {Role}WHERE clause that limits vertical (row) access per role — the source for the derived RLS plan.', 'platform', 'designed', 32, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-02,TT-RBAC-03', 'Stores a per-role row-scoping WHERE policy per table so a representative sees only their own citations while an admin sees all, expressed as data the enforced API compiles into vw_* reads. An admin authors the policy once and every query for that role is filtered. Row-level security becomes configuration, not code.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-role-specific-schemas', 'nav-admin-tables', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Role-specific schemas / column-limited views', 'Generated vw_* views per role exposing only columns whose resolved {Role}CRUD contains R (resolved via core-role-permission-model). One column-limited view per (role,table).', 'platform', 'designed', 33, TRUE, 'TT-RBAC-02,TT-RBAC-04', 'Generates role-specific, column-limited projections of each table so external-llm receives a redacted schema while admin gets the full set, derived from the field-level CRUD grid. A developer sees exactly the columns a role is entitled to. The same rulebook yields a different, safe view per audience.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-enforced-crud-api', 'nav-admin-endpoints', 'core', TRUE, 'Enforced CRUD API', 'A full CRUD API that enforces the Role→Table→Field permissions and the WHERE policies at request time.', 'platform', 'designed', 34, TRUE, 'TT-RBAC-01,TT-RBAC-02,TT-RBAC-03', 'Provides the single enforced CRUD API that reads the Role -> Table -> Field permission rows and the WHERE policies before every operation, so no caller can bypass RBAC. Every app screen and every external client goes through it. It is the one door, and the door checks the rulebook.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-rls-plan', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Derived row-level security plan', 'Derived RLS: one CREATE POLICY per (role,table) built from ERBTables.{Role}WHERE (and APIEndpoints.WhereClause for custom endpoints). NULL WHERE = no row restriction. Source for basic row-level security.', 'platform', 'designed', 35, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-03', 'Compiles the per-role WHERE policies into a derived row-level-security plan that the enforced API applies to every vw_* read, turning declarative scoping rows into actual filtered results. An admin reviews the plan to confirm a representative truly cannot see another rep''s citations. The plan is regenerated from the rulebook, never hand-maintained.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-api-endpoints', 'nav-admin-endpoints', 'platform-meta', TRUE, 'Custom API endpoints registry', 'APIEndpoints table cataloging non-CRUD endpoints (actions/RPC) in addition to the standard CRUD operations, each with its own role visibility.', 'platform', 'designed', 36, FALSE, 'TT-PLATFORM-01,TT-RBAC-01', 'Maintains a registry of every custom (non-CRUD) API endpoint as APIEndpoints rows -- method, path, subject table, role visibility, and which state machine it triggers. An admin browses the verb surface of the whole platform in one place. Loop 4 populates this registry with every traffic-ticket action.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-schema-catalog', 'nav-admin-tables', 'platform-meta', TRUE, 'Self-describing schema catalog', 'ERBTables/ERBFields are the self-describing catalog of every rulebook table and field. Build is ADDITIVE ONLY: on each run it ADDS newly-introduced tables/fields and UPDATEs derived columns (e.g. FieldCount) but NEVER overwrites or deletes existing rows, so hand-set permissions survive.', 'devops', 'designed', 37, FALSE, 'TT-PLATFORM-02', 'Exposes a self-describing schema catalog built from ERBTables and ERBFields rows so the platform can render its own data model without external documentation. A developer inspects any table''s fields, types, and descriptions in the UI. The catalog stays in sync because it is generated from the rulebook itself.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-state-machine-backbone', 'nav-admin-state-machines', 'state-machines', TRUE, 'Generic state-machine backbone', 'Four mechanic tables (StateMachines, MachineStates, StateTransitionRules, StateTransitions) plus one polymorphic transition log unify all lifecycle/audit handling.', 'platform', 'designed', 38, TRUE, 'TT-CITATION-01,TT-PLATFORM-01', 'Provides the generic state-machine backbone -- StateMachines, MachineStates, StateTransitionRules, StateTransitions, SubjectStateInstances -- that the four traffic-ticket tracks are expressed in as data. An admin defines states and guarded transitions as rows and the engine enforces them. Every lifecycle in the platform rides this one substrate.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-work-queue', 'nav-work-queue', 'core', TRUE, 'Unified work queue', 'WorkQueueItems surfaces non-terminal subjects across the platform''s lifecycle entities, ordered by urgency, via a polymorphic pointer.', 'platform', 'designed', 39, FALSE, 'TT-QUEUE-01,TT-DEADLINE-01', 'Implements the unified work queue as WorkQueueItems rows computed from deadline and status columns across vw_citations, vw_hearings, and vw_payments. Any role sees the prioritized list scoped to what they may act on. It is the single ''what needs me now'' surface for the whole platform.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-feature-status-tracking', 'nav-admin-features', 'platform-meta', TRUE, 'Feature status tracking', 'ERBFeatureStatuses meta table with IsActive to separate the official shared view from design-only (DESIGNED) features.', 'devops', 'designed', 40, FALSE, 'TT-PLATFORM-02', 'Tracks the build status of every capability via ERBFeatures.Status (FK to ERBFeatureStatuses), so the feature catalog shows designed/planned/in-progress/shipped at a glance. A product owner sees exactly what is live. This very spine row is part of that catalog.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-build-pipeline', 'nav-admin-build-pipeline', 'core', TRUE, 'Rulebook-first build pipeline', 'effortless build regenerates postgres SQL from the rulebook SSoT; init-db applies it; catalog tables are kept in sync additively.', 'devops', 'designed', 41, TRUE, 'TT-PLATFORM-01,TT-PLATFORM-03', 'Drives the rulebook-first build pipeline: editing the rulebook JSON and running effortless build regenerates Postgres, Python, explain-dag, and rulespeak with no hand-written substrate code. A developer changes a rule and rebuilds; every spoke updates. The pipeline is the mechanism that makes the SSoT actually single.', 'README.md,rulespeak/rulespeak.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-magic-link-auth', 'nav-admin-users', 'core', TRUE, 'Magic-link authentication', 'Passwordless email-code auth issuing JWTs the API verifies; feeds the role/RLS layer.', 'devops', 'designed', 42, TRUE, 'TT-AUTH-01,TT-RBAC-01', 'Authenticates users with passwordless email magic links configured in MagicLinkConfig, resolving each request to an AppUsers identity and role. A user signs in with a code and the platform knows who they are. VALUES ('core-roles-catalog-admin', 'nav-admin-roles', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Roles catalog & per-role dashboard', 'The interactive Roles catalog plus a per-role dashboard: each role opens to a hub showing its user roster, its default CRUD posture, and its redacted-role flag, with inline user-add. This is the top of the RBAC cascade made editable.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 20, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-01,TT-RBAC-02', 'Gives admins a roles catalog with a per-role dashboard summarizing each role''s table/field grants and visible navigation, reading Roles, the permission grid, and PlatformNaviation. An admin audits a role''s full reach from one screen. It turns the abstract RBAC matrix into a legible per-role story.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

This is the people side of access control, paired with the Roles catalog.', 'auth', 'shipped', 21, FALSE, 'TT-AUTH-01,TT-RBAC-01', 'Provides the App-Users directory backed by the AppUsers table for creating, editing, and assigning roles to users. An admin manages who can log in and what role they hold. INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-admin-equivalent-access', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Admin-equivalent cross-world access', 'Roles flagged admin-equivalent may browse any role''s URL world (/admin, /reps, /llm); everyone else is bounced to their own home world. This is what lets an administrator move freely across the three role surfaces.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 22, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-03,TT-RBAC-01', 'Grants admin (and admin-equivalent) roles cross-world access so they can read and act across every jurisdiction and every representative''s caseload, enforced via the WHERE policies. An admin troubleshoots any citation regardless of owner. The breadth is itself a configured policy, not a hardcoded superuser bypass.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-role-url-worlds', 'nav-admin-route-designer', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Role URL worlds (/admin · /reps · /llm)', 'Every role gets its own slug-prefixed URL world, so the same React app presents a different navigable surface per role. The home world, redirects, and sidebar all key off the active slug.', 'navigation', 'shipped', 23, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-04,TT-NAV-01', 'Routes each role into its own URL world (/admin, /reps, /llm) so navigation, scoping, and chrome match the actor, driven by PlatformNaviation RoleVisibility. A representative lands in /reps and sees only their tools. The same rulebook produces a tailored app per role.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-role-impersonation', 'nav-admin-users', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Role impersonation (view-as-role)', 'An admin can browse the platform exactly as another (redacted) role sees it by entering the External-LLM world, which sends an X-Impersonate-Role header so the API returns that role''s filtered, redacted projection.', 'auth', 'shipped', 24, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-04,TT-AUTH-01', 'Lets an admin view-as-role to see precisely what a representative or external-llm would see, applying that role''s permission and WHERE policies live. An admin verifies redaction and scoping by walking in the role''s shoes. It is a debugging superpower that never weakens the real policies.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-default-crud-editor', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Per-role default CRUD editor', 'The four-state Create/Read/Update/Delete control at the top of the cascade: each role''s default posture is set with an inherit / grant / deny tri-state, and every table and field falls back to it unless overridden.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 25, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-02', 'Provides a per-role default CRUD editor that sets the baseline create/read/update/delete a role gets on a table before field-level overrides, stored as permission rows. An admin sets sane defaults once. Field grids then refine the exceptions.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-table-where-policy-editor', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Per-table CRUD + WHERE policy editor', 'On each table''s detail page an admin sets per-role CRUD overrides and a per-role WHERE clause that limits which rows that role can see. The WHERE policies are the source for the derived row-level-security plan.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 26, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-03,TT-RBAC-02', 'A per-table CRUD + WHERE policy editor where an admin authors the row-scoping expression that filters a role''s reads of that table''s vw_*. An admin writes ''driver = current_user'' once for representatives. The enforced API compiles it on every query.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-field-crud-grid', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Per-field CRUD permission grid', 'A column-level grid where each field''s CRUD is granted or denied per role. Denied fields drop out of that role''s column-limited views, which is how role-specific schemas are produced.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 27, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-02,TT-RBAC-04', 'A per-field CRUD permission grid that controls, column by column, what each role may read or write across every table, persisted as permission rows that the role-specific schemas derive from. An admin redacts a PII column for external-llm with one toggle. Granularity is data, not branching code.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-redaction-sweep', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Role-wide PII redaction sweep', 'Marking a role redacted runs a one-click sweep that bulk-denies every PII field carrying a *Redacted sibling, so the role transparently receives masked values instead of raw personal data across all tables.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 28, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-04', 'Runs a role-wide PII redaction sweep that flags every sensitive field (driver address, license number) and ensures the field grid denies it to lower-trust roles. An admin confirms no PII leaks to external-llm in one pass. The sweep reads the field catalog and the grid together.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-redacted-projection', 'nav-admin-endpoints', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Redacted-response projection', 'When a redacted role (or an impersonation/LLM session) reads data, the server swaps in *_redacted columns so personal identifiers are masked in the response body itself — not merely hidden in the UI.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 29, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-04', 'Produces the redacted-response projection the enforced API returns to a role, stripping denied columns from every vw_* result before it leaves the server. An external-llm receives a citation with PII columns absent, not nulled-after-the-fact. Redaction happens at projection time, deterministically.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

INSERT INTO erb_features (erb_feature_id, route, erb_package, is_licensed, title, description, category, status, sort_order, is_key, rule_refs, source_text, source_files, image_url, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, modified_by_model)
VALUES ('core-derived-rls', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Derived row-level security enforcement', 'The per-role WHERE policies and CRUD grants are compiled into role-scoped Postgres views and a search_path so that reads are filtered in the database itself, regardless of what the API or UI does.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 30, TRUE, 'TT-RBAC-03', 'Enforces derived row-level security by applying the compiled WHERE-policy plan to every read, so a representative''s query of vw_citations is silently scoped to their own rows. A rep simply cannot fetch another rep''s data. The enforcement is generated from the rulebook, audited, and uniform.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-live-identity', 'nav-admin-users', 'access-control', TRUE, 'Live per-request identity resolution', 'The JWT carries only an email; the role, redaction flag, and licensing visibility are looked up live from AppUsers on every request, so revoking or re-roling a user takes effect immediately without re-issuing tokens.', 'auth', 'shipped', 31, FALSE, 'TT-AUTH-01,TT-RBAC-01', 'Resolves live per-request identity from the magic-link session to an AppUsers row and role on every call, feeding RBAC and scoping with the actual current actor. The platform always knows who is asking right now. Stale or assumed identity is never used.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-route-designer', 'nav-admin-route-designer', 'core', TRUE, 'Route Designer (drag-drop nav tree)', 'A live, drag-and-drop editor for the entire platform navigation tree: reparent and reorder routes, edit their fields inline, create and delete routes, and set a per-route CRUD matrix — then SAVE promotes the tree back to the rulebook.', 'navigation', 'shipped', 20, TRUE, 'TT-NAV-01,TT-NAV-02', 'Offers a drag-and-drop Route Designer that edits the PlatformNaviation tree -- parent/child, level, role-visibility, pin-to-top -- as data that the live sidebar renders. An admin reorganizes the whole app''s navigation without touching code. The nav tree is rulebook rows end to end.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-live-sidebar', 'nav-admin-route-designer', 'core', TRUE, 'Live DB-driven sidebar', 'The sidebar is rendered entirely from the navigation table in the database: package-gated, role-filtered, with empty feature-status buckets auto-hidden and the active record''s context grafted in. Edit the routes and the menu changes.', 'navigation', 'shipped', 21, TRUE, 'TT-NAV-01,TT-RBAC-04', 'Renders a live DB-driven sidebar straight from PlatformNaviation rows filtered by the current role''s RoleVisibility. A user''s menu always matches the rulebook and their permissions. There is no hand-maintained menu file to drift.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-pin-to-top', 'nav-admin-route-designer', 'core', TRUE, 'Pin-to-top routes', 'A per-route PinToTop flag floats important destinations to the top of the sidebar regardless of their position in the tree, so high-traffic admin pages stay one click away.', 'navigation', 'shipped', 22, FALSE, 'TT-NAV-02', 'Supports pin-to-top routes via a PlatformNaviation.PinToTop flag so high-traffic screens (Work Queue, Citations) float above the long tail. An admin pins the screens reps use most. Ordering is data the sidebar honors.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-route-galleries', 'nav-admin-route-designer', 'core', TRUE, 'By-Role / By-Package route galleries', 'Two read-only regroupings of the same navigation set — one grouped by the roles that can reach each route, one by owning package — for auditing coverage at a glance; clicking jumps to that route in the designer tree.', 'navigation', 'shipped', 23, FALSE, 'TT-NAV-01,TT-PLATFORM-02', 'Generates By-Role and By-Package route galleries from PlatformNaviation so an admin can audit the app from either lens -- what each role sees, or what each package contributes. VALUES ('core-route-access-gating', 'nav-admin-route-designer', 'core', TRUE, 'Per-route access gating', 'Visiting a URL a role isn''t permitted to read renders an Access-Denied surface instead of the page, enforced in the shell from the same permission data that filters the sidebar — so deep links can''t bypass the menu.', 'navigation', 'shipped', 24, FALSE, 'TT-NAV-01,TT-RBAC-04', 'Gates each route by RoleVisibility so navigating to a screen a role may not see returns a clean denial instead of a broken page, enforced from PlatformNaviation. A representative who edits the URL still cannot reach an admin screen. Access is checked against the rulebook on every navigation.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-nav-backed-pages', 'nav-admin-route-designer', 'core', TRUE, 'Generic nav-backed pages', 'Any navigation row that names a primary_view auto-renders a live, RLS-backed data grid plus a drill-down detail page — no bespoke component required. VALUES ('core-unlicensed-reveal', 'nav-admin-packages', 'core', TRUE, 'Unlicensed-surface reveal', 'The vendor-only mechanism that lets Effortless staff see surfaces marked unlicensed, while accounts see them hidden. It is the internal key behind every per-feature, per-table, and per-package licensing toggle.', 'licensing', 'shipped', 27, FALSE, 'TT-LICENSE-PKG-01', 'Reveals unlicensed surfaces in a muted state -- features, tables, or routes whose ERBPackage is not licensed are shown as upgrade prompts rather than hidden -- driven by the IsLicensed flags. A buyer sees what the next tier unlocks. Licensing is presentation data, not a deleted feature.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-save-to-rulebook', 'nav-admin-build-pipeline', 'core', TRUE, 'SAVE: DB → rulebook → rebuild', 'The promotion action behind every admin editor: it exports the live admin-config tables out of Postgres back into the rulebook JSON, runs effortless build, then re-initializes the database — turning fast in-DB edits into the new source of truth.', 'devops', 'shipped', 28, TRUE, 'TT-PLATFORM-01,TT-PLATFORM-03', 'Implements SAVE: edits made in the admin UI write back to the rulebook JSON and trigger a rebuild, so the DB -> rulebook -> rebuild loop closes from inside the app. An admin changes a deadline and the rulebook plus all substrates update. The app edits its own source of truth.', 'README.md,rulespeak/rulespeak.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-drift-guard', 'nav-admin-build-pipeline', 'core', TRUE, 'Rulebook drift guard', 'Before a SAVE overwrites the rulebook, a guard checks whether the rulebook is newer than the last build manifest; if so it blocks with a 409 until the operator explicitly forces the write, preventing a stale admin session from clobbering newer changes.', 'devops', 'shipped', 29, FALSE, 'TT-PLATFORM-03', 'Adds a rulebook drift guard that detects when the live DB diverges from the rulebook JSON and surfaces it before a rebuild silently reverts edits. An admin is warned instead of losing work. The guard protects the SSoT from accidental clobber.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-config-export-scope', 'nav-admin-build-pipeline', 'core', TRUE, 'Config-export scope', 'The defined set of admin-config tables the exporter promotes on SAVE — navigation, packages, roles, tables, fields, endpoints, glossary, business rules, state machines, and branding — deliberately excluding operational data, which resets to seeds on rebuild.', 'devops', 'shipped', 30, FALSE, 'TT-PLATFORM-03,TT-LICENSE-PKG-01', 'Lets an admin choose the config-export scope -- which packages, tables, and routes ship in an exported rulebook -- so a tenant gets exactly the licensed subset. An admin exports a representative-only build. Scope is selected from the catalog, not edited by hand.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-permission-sync', 'nav-admin-permissions', 'core', TRUE, 'Non-destructive permission sync', 'A script that pushes the rulebook''s RBAC matrix into the live database without a full destructive init-db, so permission tweaks can be applied to a running instance while leaving operational data intact.', 'devops', 'shipped', 31, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-02,TT-PLATFORM-03', 'Performs non-destructive permission sync: when new tables or fields appear, default grants are added without overwriting an admin''s existing customizations in the permission grid. VALUES ('core-endpoint-access-editor', 'nav-admin-endpoints', 'platform-meta', TRUE, 'Per-endpoint access editor', 'An editor for the custom API-endpoint registry where each endpoint, grouped by its subject table, gets a role allow-list and an optional WHERE clause — extending the same role/row scoping used on tables to bespoke endpoints.', 'permissions', 'shipped', 20, FALSE, 'TT-RBAC-01,TT-PLATFORM-01', 'A per-endpoint access editor that sets RoleVisibility on each APIEndpoints row, so a contest action is available to representatives but a refund only to managers. Endpoint security is a row, edited in the UI.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

An admin turns the assistant package off for a tenant. The toggle cascades through the catalog.', 'README.md,EXPANSION-PLAN.md', '', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T00:00:00Z', 'admin-example', NULL) ON CONFLICT (erb_feature_id) DO UPDATE SET route = EXCLUDED.route, erb_package = EXCLUDED.erb_package, is_licensed = EXCLUDED.is_licensed, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, is_key = EXCLUDED.is_key, rule_refs = EXCLUDED.rule_refs, source_text = EXCLUDED.source_text, source_files = EXCLUDED.source_files, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by, modified_by_model = EXCLUDED.modified_by_model;

VALUES ('core-table-route-licensing', 'nav-admin-packages', 'platform-meta', TRUE, 'Per-table & per-route licensing toggles', 'Licensing flags at the individual table and route level, so a single catalog table or navigation destination can be hidden from accounts without disabling its whole package — the finest grain of the licensing model.', 'licensing', 'shipped', 24, FALSE, 'TT-LICENSE-PKG-01', 'Adds per-table and per-route licensing toggles (IsLicensed on ERBTables and PlatformNaviation) so a tier can expose a screen while withholding the underlying editable table. The schema describes itself, so the catalog is generated, never hand-listed.', 'data-model', 'shipped', 25, TRUE, 'TT-PLATFORM-02', 'Renders the self-describing table catalog from ERBTables rows -- name, package, field count, catalog flag, per-role CRUD -- so the platform documents its own schema. VALUES ('core-feature-catalog-grid', 'nav-admin-features', 'platform-meta', TRUE, 'Feature catalog grid (filterable cards)', 'The Features page itself: a horizontal, filterable grid where every feature is a card with its own logo, searchable and narrowable by two orthogonal axes — lifecycle status and functional category. This very catalog is the feature.', 'platform', 'shipped', 28, TRUE, 'TT-PLATFORM-02', 'Presents the feature catalog as a filterable grid of cards from ERBFeatures, each with title, status, package, and cartoon logo. VALUES ('PlatformNaviation.HandlerBaseName', 'PlatformNaviation', 'HandlerBaseName', 'calculated', 'string', 'Calculated — space-delimited form of the dotted RouteKey (dots and hyphens become spaces), e.g. ''library rules detail''. VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-PAYMENT-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-PAYMENT-01 — Payment track derives from payments and pay-by date', 'PaymentStatus (Pending -> Due -> Late -> Collections | Paid | NotOwed) is computed from Payments rows and the jurisdiction pay-by date.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'Citations', NULL, 'TT-PAYMENT-01', 'high', TRUE, 167, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-PAYMENT-02', 'Rule enforced: TT-PAYMENT-02 — Late penalty applies after the pay-by date', 'Once the pay-by date passes with no full payment, the jurisdiction''s LatePenaltyPercent is added to AmountOwed.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'Citations', NULL, 'TT-PAYMENT-02', 'high', TRUE, 168, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-PAYMENT-03', 'Rule enforced: TT-PAYMENT-03 — Paid in full closes the case', 'When recorded Payments equal AmountOwed, PaymentStatus becomes Paid and the citation advances toward Closed.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'Payments', NULL, 'TT-PAYMENT-03', 'high', TRUE, 169, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-FEE-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-FEE-01 — Base fine comes from the violation and jurisdiction', 'The base fine is the ViolationType base amount adjusted by the jurisdiction''s fee schedule; it is data, not a constant.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'Citations', NULL, 'TT-FEE-01', 'high', TRUE, 170, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-LICENSE-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-LICENSE-01 — Active points roll up across a driver''s citations', 'A driver''s ActivePoints is the sum of points from non-dismissed, non-expired citations under each jurisdiction''s point window.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'Drivers', NULL, 'TT-LICENSE-01', 'high', TRUE, 171, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-QUEUE-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-QUEUE-01 — Work queue is computed from deadlines and status', 'WorkQueueItems are derived from overdue responses, due/late payments, and upcoming hearings, bucketed by urgency; nothing is hand-enqueued.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'WorkQueueItems <- Citations / Hearings / Payments', NULL, 'TT-QUEUE-01', 'high', TRUE, 173, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-RBAC-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-RBAC-01 — Four canonical roles govern access', 'Exactly four roles exist (admin, manager, representative, external-llm) and every permission decision references one of them.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'Roles', NULL, 'TT-RBAC-01', 'high', TRUE, 180, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-RBAC-04', 'Rule enforced: TT-RBAC-04 — Lower-trust roles get redacted projections', 'Fields denied to a role (e.g. PII for external-llm) are stripped from responses at projection time, not nulled afterward.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'ERBFields (field CRUD) / role-specific views', NULL, 'TT-RBAC-04', 'high', TRUE, 183, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-NAV-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-NAV-01 — Navigation is derived from PlatformNaviation rows', 'The sidebar and route tree render from PlatformNaviation filtered by the current role''s RoleVisibility; there is no hand-maintained menu.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'PlatformNaviation', NULL, 'TT-NAV-01', 'high', TRUE, 184, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-LICENSE-PKG-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-LICENSE-PKG-01 — Surfaces are gated by license/active flags', 'Packages, features, tables, and routes carry IsLicensed/IsActive flags; unlicensed surfaces are revealed as upgrade prompts, not deleted.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'ERBPackages', NULL, 'TT-LICENSE-PKG-01', 'high', TRUE, 187, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-PLATFORM-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-PLATFORM-01 — The rulebook JSON is the single source of truth', 'All substrates (Postgres, Python, explain-dag, rulespeak) are mechanically derived from the rulebook by effortless build; edits go to the rulebook.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'traffic-ticket-contest-rulebook', NULL, 'TT-PLATFORM-01', 'high', TRUE, 188, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-PLATFORM-02', 'Rule enforced: TT-PLATFORM-02 — The platform describes itself', 'ERBTables/ERBFields/ERBFeatures/ERBPackages catalog every table, field, capability, and package so the app can render its own model.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'ERBTables / ERBFields / ERBFeatures / ERBPackages', NULL, 'TT-PLATFORM-02', 'high', TRUE, 189, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-PLATFORM-03', 'Rule enforced: TT-PLATFORM-03 — Build is generate + load; drift is guarded', 'effortless build regenerates DDL/views/inserts and reloads the DB; a drift guard warns before a rebuild would clobber un-saved DB edits.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'postgres-bootstrap/* / build pipeline', NULL, 'TT-PLATFORM-03', 'high', TRUE, 190, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-GLOSSARY-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-GLOSSARY-01 — Domain terms are defined as data', 'Every domain term used in a feature or rule is defined in GlossaryTerms under a GlossaryCategories group.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'GlossaryTerms / GlossaryCategories', NULL, 'TT-GLOSSARY-01', 'high', TRUE, 191, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-DETERMINATION-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-DETERMINATION-01 — Determination is recorded', 'A hearing determination (upheld / dismissed / reduced) must be recorded on the Citation before the citation-lifecycle may advance to adjudicated, and it writes a CaseEvents entry.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'Citations', NULL, 'TT-DETERMINATION-01', 'high', TRUE, 192, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-DETERMINATION-02', 'Rule enforced: TT-DETERMINATION-02 — Dismissal reverses consequences', 'When a determination dismisses a Citation, any assessed license points are reversed and any paid amount is refunded, restoring the Driver to make-whole state.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'Citations', NULL, 'TT-DETERMINATION-02', 'high', TRUE, 193, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;

VALUES ('tc-rule-TT-STATE-01', 'Rule enforced: TT-STATE-01 — Lifecycle transitions are guarded', 'Every state transition is gated by its guard condition and the firing role; the state-machine backbone rejects illegal transitions and logs each accepted one to CaseEvents.', 'rules', 'rules', 'sql', NULL, NULL, 'StateTransitionRules', NULL, 'TT-STATE-01', 'high', TRUE, 194, '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example', '2026-06-07T19:30:00Z', 'admin-example') ON CONFLICT (test_case_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, test_category = EXCLUDED.test_category, test_surface = EXCLUDED.test_surface, test_technology = EXCLUDED.test_technology, target_feature = EXCLUDED.target_feature, target_endpoint = EXCLUDED.target_endpoint, target_table = EXCLUDED.target_table, target_transition = EXCLUDED.target_transition, business_rule_refs = EXCLUDED.business_rule_refs, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, order_index = EXCLUDED.order_index, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, modified_at = EXCLUDED.modified_at, modified_by = EXCLUDED.modified_by;
